stem: A two-year-old industry article says a state uses one hemp licensing model, while the current USDA plan-status page shows a different program status. What should drive the next verification step?
choices: The current official USDA status plus the current responsible program documents
The older article because it is easier to read
Whichever source permits the planned activity
A forum discussion about the state
rationale: Current primary program sources should control the verification process; secondary material can provide context but not replace current authority.
